title: One by One
body: The weekly missionary coordination meeting, step by step. Each week, ward leaders and missionaries counsel together to help each person take the next step on the covenant path. Huddle keeps that plan in one place, on your phone.

title: Four steps, in order
body:
1. Before ward council
2. Ward council
3. The Huddle
4. After the huddle
Up next shows where you are. A finished step gets a green check.

title: Open the Covenant Path Report
body: Open the report in Member Tools and make this list match it: add or remove names so everyone is listed.

title: Tap each name
body: Add any dates, and check off what the report shows they’ve done. A check means done.

title: Check off what’s done
body: Each person has the checklist from their report. Baptisms for the dead stays red, with its 30-day countdown, until it’s checked.

title: Mark it done
body: When the names match the report, tap Mark done. It stays at the bottom of the screen.

title: Who and what
body: Step 1 has its green check. Ward council is up next.

title: Counsel together
body: Work down the cards. Up next shows where you are, and a finished card gets a green check.

title: What’s coming up
body: Add each upcoming event and its event date. If there are none, tap No upcoming events.

title: Suggested focus names
body: Look in the Covenant Path Report and the Part-Member Families list. Pressing names are marked red: a new member who hasn’t been to the temple, or someone with a baptism or missionary appointment coming up.

title: Questions to guide you
body: On each Covenant Path Report list, tap How can we help? for the questions in Preach My Gospel, chapter 13.

title: Make focus name
body: Tap it, and the huddle plans their action item. Their next ordinance and needs come along.

title: Give each a next ordinance
body: Your focus names sit right on Ward Council. Tap one and choose its next ordinance. Tap Suggested to use the one their report points to.

title: Focus names done
body: Once every focus name has a next ordinance, the card turns green. Swipe a name left to remove it.

title: How and when
body: The Huddle is the weekly coordination meeting: brief, focused, and about people.

title: Four sections
body: Return and Report and Sacrament attendance, then the Huddle action plan: Opportunities to invite and Focus names.

title: Who came
body: In Huddle Attendees, tap everyone who attended. Make an extra effort to involve the youth.

title: Did it happen?
body: Last week’s assignments come back here. Tap Yes, Partly or No, and add a short note on how it went.

title: One tap each
body: Tap each person who attended sacrament meeting. One tap each.

title: Love, share, invite
body: Each opportunity opens on its own screen. Add an assignment, tap a way to invite, then add who and when.

title: One person at a time
body: Tap each focus name to plan how the ward will help this week.

title: One action item
body: What will we do this week to help them toward their next ordinance? Tap something still open on their report or an idea, or type your own. Then who and when.

title: Text this assignment
body: Send each assignment by text, so the person asked to help knows exactly what, for whom, and when.

title: Never add confidential information
body: This reminder sits under the notes. Everyone who receives the huddle report can read it. Keep it to names, ordinances and simple needs.

title: A plan for every focus name
body: Each name now shows its action item, who, and when.

title: All four sections done
body: Mark each section done as you go. The bar fills in.

title: Up next: After the huddle
body: Three green checks. One step left before you send.

title: Update the Covenant Path Report
body: This page lists only what changed. Go back to the Covenant Path Report and update it with the new information.

title: Mark it done
body: Anyone marked Changed has updates since step 1. Update the report, then tap Mark done.

title: All four steps done
body: Send turns solid blue. Tap it.

title: Share the huddle report
body: Send it to the bishop-approved list, the stake presidency and the full-time missionaries, and include yourself. Only share via email or text message. Do not share through any other app.

title: Sent
body: This week’s assignments move to Return and Report for next time. Names and needs stay for ward council.

title: Follow up
body: As people report back, mark each assignment Yes, Partly or No. Offer help where it’s needed.

title: One by one
body: Helping each person take the next step on the covenant path, together as a ward.
fine: Never add confidential information to this huddle report.
